blocks.tamil_translation: in his Du'a — that verse. (رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ )كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ ج فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّيْرَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ ج فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّيْ “My Rabb, these idols have led a great many people astray. (Therefore I make Du'a that You protect me and my descendants from idol worship. Likewise, I keep stopping my people from worshipping them.) Then (after I have called them), whoever accepts my word is indeed of me (and forgiveness has been promised to him). And whoever does not obey me, (grant him Hidayah, for) You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful. (The purpose of this Du'a of Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) is to intercede for the believers and to ask for the straight path for those who do not believe.) And the Prophet ﷺ also recited the Ayah of the Du'a made by Hazrat Isa (AS). (إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ج وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ) “If You punish them, they are only Your servants (You are their Owner, and the owner has the right to punish the slaves for the crimes they commit). If You forgive them, You are the Almighty (the All-Powerful). (So You also have the power to forgive.) And You are All-Wise and All-Subtle. Therefore Your forgiveness too will be in keeping with Your profound wisdom. On reciting these two Ayahs (the Prophet ﷺ was reminded of his Ummah), the Prophet ﷺ, raising his hands to make Du'a, said, “O Allah, my Ummah, my Ummah,” and began to weep. Allah sent Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), saying, “O Jibra'il! Go to Muhammad ﷺ; your Rabb knows everything, yet you ask him, ‘What is the reason for your weeping?’” Accordingly, Hazrat Jibra'il (AS)
